detail: The paper's maximal values (heart rate and lactate at the end of a 100 W, +25 W per minute ramp to exhaustion, whose end minute varies between people: mean 9:27 PRE, 10:06 POST) are the gap named here, as in schild-2016 and muramoto-2025; adding it would let the PRE maxima be written. The paper's central comparison is also not writable: the POST values follow 60 h of sleep deprivation, and the meals of those days (and of the days before the PRE test) are not printed, so they are input prior_day_condition, as in vanleeuwen-2010. The 275 W lactate at 8 min is not written because the paper prints n = 10 for the aerobic test but gives counts of 9, 8 and 4 for 'the last 3 workloads' without saying which loads those are, so the n of that value is not stated.
